summary: D.C. statehood advocates are advancing their campaign ahead of the midterm elections, with some lawmakers pledging support for the cause. Recent events, including a federal takeover and National Guard deployment in the District, have intensified calls for statehood as a means to protect D.C.'s autonomy. Without statehood, Congress can override any law the District passes and can intervene directly in D.C. governance, including deploying federal troops within the District's borders.
